name: Dumbbell Lying Rear Delt Row
steps: Lie face down on a flat bench with feet braced and your chest supported on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing back and arms hanging straight below your shoulders.
Drive your elbows out wide to the sides until your upper arms reach bench height.
Pause briefly squeezing your rear delts, then lower the dumbbells smoothly until your arms hang straight.
tips: Keep your forearms pointing straight toward the floor at the top of the row.
Keep your chest resting flat and your neck neutral without shrugging your shoulders.
